anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: Persistence stays scoped / the iteration's own 'Real (non-fixture) computes are OUT OF SCOPE' rule — no verification lane may write into the operator's real store unasked
anti_goal_violations.evidence: STILL OPEN, but materially narrowed by iteration 7. The permanent iter-6 record apps/backend/.data/playbook/playbook-2026-08-07-84fcd116ebd7.json (57 signals) stays by design (deleting it would breach the append-only rail). Iteration 7 shipped the process remedy for the LLM browser lane: apps/backend/scripts/qa_playbook_iter7_fixture_scoped_backend.sh exports all four playbook env vars, desk_playbook_backscan._assert_scoped refuses an unscoped rig, and the browser-qa agent detected and replaced an unscoped ambient :8301 backend before testing. Evaluator-verified: `find apps/backend/.data -newermt '2026-08-11 11:40' -type f` returns only sqlite WAL/SHM sidecars — zero playbook writes this iteration. REMAINING HOLE: the deterministic golden-replay lane ran at 12:40 against that same unscoped ambient backend, and two golden scripts (J-01.json, J-03.json) click the Run Playbook compute trigger; both used non-session dates so the honest refusal fired and nothing was written, but the lane is still not pinned to the scoped rig.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: The spec is canonical (Constraints) — 'a developer who finds the spec ambiguous or unimplementable DROPS that detector and surfaces it, never improvises a rule'
anti_goal_violations.evidence: OPEN — owner ratification pending. Closing audit finding B2 (a long could be served with invalidation above its own entry), the developer wrote the dated 'degenerate trigger reference' clarification into docs/playbook-detector-spec.md §3.7 and only then made _range_trade_side void T <= SL (long) / T >= SH (short). Iteration 7 added the short-side mirror test (tests/test_desk_playbook_detect.py, TC-12) with zero diff to desk_playbook_detect.py, which strengthens the evidence but does NOT ratify the rule. Rejecting it means dropping range_trade from PLAYBOOK_SETUPS.

anti_goal_violations.anti_goal: The spec is canonical (Constraints) — served detector behaviour must match the canonical spec
anti_goal_violations.evidence: OPEN — three disclosed, fail-closed divergences between the shipped code and the canonical spec (the crossed_midrange partial disclosure, double_top's first-pair-vs-first-break choice, and the 1.5x jump-to-base gate / cup rim constant questions). Each can only produce FEWER signals, never invented ones. Untouched by iteration 7 by design (explicitly OUT OF SCOPE); awaiting owner rulings.
